about: The Claude StrongREJECT judges' item rows and filed ASR run metrics of ten paper runs, one judgment each: the oracle the control-pool appendix's StrongREJECT reduction is held to (it must reproduce every filed k from the item rows at thresholds 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75). Rows: [item index, metric index, trial, value]; the items' ids are replaced by their position (a reduction groups by item and never reads its name).
